subject: english
stem: Which pair correctly uses a few and a little?
options: a few questions and a little patience
a little questions and a few patience

optionRationales.reason: much questions and many patience：many/much 也顛倒。
a few questions and a little patience：questions 可數；patience 不可數。
a little questions and a few patience：量詞顛倒。
few patience and little questions：兩邊可數性皆錯。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「依名詞可數性選 a few 或 a little，並辨識帶 a 的少量肯定與不帶 a 的幾乎不足語意。」可推出 a few questions and a little patience；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 a few questions and a little patience 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
